classification.difficultyReason: Invert secant to obtain cosine, construct a reference triangle using Pythagoras, select the quadrant III sine sign, and form cotangent.

content.prompt: Find the exact value of $\cot\theta$, given that $\sec\theta=-\frac{7}{3}$ and $\theta\in(180^{\circ},270^{\circ})$.

answer.short:
$\frac{3\sqrt{10}}{20}$

Use a reference triangle and Pythagoras; sine and cosine are both negative in quadrant III.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{1}{\sec\theta}\\\cos\theta&=-\frac{3}{7}\end{align*}$$
The reference triangle has adjacent side $3$ and hypotenuse $7$. By Pythagoras,
$$\begin{align*}o&=\sqrt{7^2-3^2}\\o&=2\sqrt{10}\end{align*}$$
Sine is negative in quadrant III.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=-\frac{2\sqrt{10}}{7}\\\cot\theta&=\frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}\\\cot\theta&=\frac{-3/7}{-2\sqrt{10}/7}\\\cot\theta&=\frac{3}{2\sqrt{10}}\\\cot\theta&=\frac{3\sqrt{10}}{20}\end{align*}$$
